subject: Hosted API: Commit scale & rate harmonization for AIOpsX
messages:
From: Jordan Keller <jkeller@aiopsx.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@aiopsx.com
Date: Tue, 01 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted capacity increase + rate guidance

Hi Karthik,

Quick note — AIOpsX is seeing a sustained lift in inference volume for our incident summarization and alert enrichment pipelines. We've projected a 3x month-over-month token increase for H2 and want to avoid overage shocks.

We'd like to discuss: 1) moving from our current hosted monthly commit (250M tokens) to a higher committed tier (750M tokens), 2) smoothing rate bands for predictable per-token pricing across bursts, and 3) ensuring rate limits/soft-throttles won't introduce unexpected latencies for our critical paths.

Attached a short usage export (Q4) to give you context. Who should we loop in from your side for an ops + procurement-ready proposal?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Keller
Head of Platform
AIOpsX

--Attachment: aiops_usage_report_Q4.pdf (summary CSV inside)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Keller <jkeller@aiopsx.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, procure@aiopsx.com
Date: Wed, 02 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity increase + rate guidance

Jordan — thanks for the context and the export. Quick acknowledgement: we can absolutely support a staged move to a 750M committed tier with a phased billing cadence to match your ramp.

High-level proposal we think makes sense:
- 3-month phased commit ladder: 400M (month 1) -> 575M (month 2) -> 750M (month 3)
- Soft-throttle policy: preserve single-request latency SLOs for requests under 2k tokens; apply soft queuing for heavier batched jobs with a 30s upper bound and priority lanes for critical real-time endpoints
- Rateband smoothing: we propose a blended per-token rate for the first 750M and explicit burst credits for seasonal spikes; will include a hard cap option if you prefer predictability

I want to bring operations and legal into the loop. Looping in Lauren from Renewals for contract cadence. Lauren — can you prepare an amendment draft and confirm any discount thresholds at 750M commit?

Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, Jordan Keller <jkeller@aiopsx.com>, procure@aiopsx.com
Date: Mon, 06 Feb 2028 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity increase + rate guidance

Thanks Karthik — I reviewed the usage export. A few operational + contract notes:

- Discounting: at a 750M committed tier we can offer a 18% blended discount off list per-token rates if customer commits to 12 months. For a 6-month commitment the discount is 12%.
- Billing cadence: recommend monthly bill with an upfront first-month invoice and prepaid burst-credit bucket (prorated). Treasury prefers PO + single invoice for the first quarter on larger deals.
- SLA & rate limits: we can map specific endpoints to the "priority lane" with guaranteed latency band (p99 under 250ms) tied to the commitment. Ops will need a short integration window to configure routing and KV-cache warmup.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik: share target start month for phased ladder
2) Jordan: confirm internal sign-off (platform + procurement) on the 12-month vs 6-month preference
3) Lauren: I'll draft an amendment V1 and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) — attaching draft.

-Lauren
Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: redwood_draft_amendment_v1.docx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, procure@aiopsx.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API commit plan + DocuSign (AIOpsX)

Jordan — following up with an operations-ready plan and the MAP attached. Summary below and next steps to finalize: 

Summary of negotiated terms:
- Commit ladder: 400M (Mar 2028) -> 575M (Apr 2028) -> 750M (May 2028)
- Term: 12 months from May 1, 2028 with 18% blended discount on committed volume
- Burst pocket: 150M prepaid burst credits available monthly (prorated first month)
- Priority lane: p99 latency guarantee for two named endpoints (incident-summary, enrichment-api) with ops playbook for traffic-shaping
- Billing: monthly invoices, first invoice covering March + prepaid burst bucket; Procurement requested PO number to be referenced on invoices

Action items:
- Jordan: confirm PO cadence and whether Procurement will sign via DocuSign (link below) or return a signed PDF
- Procurement: if running internal review, please send redlines to lauren_bishop@redwood.ai by Fri 02/17
- Lauren/Steph: finalize amendment V1 with explicit SLA language and ops runbook; expect to push to DocuSign by EOD 02/16

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/sign/ABC123-aiopex

Thanks all — happy to hop on a 30m call if you'd prefer to review live.

Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
